The problem this solution exists for
Fraud moves at event speed while defenses run batch; false positives burn good customers; investigations drown; regulators want the decision trail.
Our approach

We build the streaming decision hub: features at event time, models + policy layers with champion-challenger, network analytics for organized fraud, and decision replay that answers auditors in minutes.
Components

items: Sub-second scoring with policy and replay
Model and policy improvement on evidence
Watchlist and monitoring within the hub

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Nexus and Dataq Forge: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision. The governed data estate every AI program needs.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline with your team: the current metric is measured, signed and stored as the reference for every later gate. Weeks 3–8 run the pilot on deliberately narrow scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, never quietly extended.
